extensionDescription.message: Privacy-first local warnings for long ChatGPT conversations on Chrome and Edge.

riskAdviceLong.message: This chat is getting long. Consider organizing important context.

riskAdviceOrganize.message: Prepare to continue in a new chat soon.

riskAdviceHigh.message: Continue in a new chat now.

riskAdviceHighConservative.message: High risk based on a conservative local reference. Continue in a new chat now.

statusUncalibratedHelp.message: Current chat length is recognized. To enable advance warnings, calibrate once with a historical chat you know reached the conversation-length limit.

statusCalibratingHelp.message: Reading the full chat. Keep this conversation open until calibration finishes.

statusMeasurementUncertainHelp.message: This page cannot be measured reliably right now, so LongChat Guard will not guess.

statusEnvironmentUnknownHelp.message: The current model or environment is not observable yet. LongChat Guard will keep risk unknown and automatically restore the calibration if the same environment becomes verifiable.

statusEnvironmentUnverifiedHelp.message: The current model cannot be reliably confirmed. The bar shows position against your local historical reference, not an official ChatGPT limit.

statusStaleHelp.message: The current observable environment is confirmed to differ from the calibration environment. Calibrate again before relying on risk levels.

statusConservativeCalibration.message: Reference established. Model information or other context could not be measured precisely during calibration, so alerts are intentionally more conservative.

statusGrowthLearning.message: Reference established. LongChat Guard is still learning typical whole-turn growth; until then it only warns at the empirical failure reference.

actionCalibrateThisChatHelp.message: Only use a historical chat you know reached the conversation-length limit.

actionMeasureCurrentChatHelp.message: Use this to determine the current risk of an older chat. This does not change your alert reference.

measurementNoConversation.message: Open the chat you want to measure, then try again.

measurementScanIncomplete.message: The full chat could not be read, so this chat's risk was not updated. Keep the page open and try again.

measurementParserFailed.message: This chat could not be measured reliably because some message roles could not be read.

measurementScanSuccess.message: Full chat read complete. LongChat Guard can now assess this chat using your existing alert reference.

measurementConversationChanged.message: The chat changed while it was being read. Nothing was updated; keep this chat open and try again.

measurementGenerationChanged.message: The alert reference changed while this chat was being read. Nothing was updated; try again.

measurementSampleUnusable.message: This chat could not be measured reliably enough to determine its current risk.

measurementScanFailed.message: The full chat could not be read, so this chat's risk was not updated.

passiveLimitHelp.message: Use this chat as a calibration sample only if you know this was the conversation-length limit.

consentLocalRead.message: Reads visible ChatGPT content locally to estimate long-chat risk.

consentNoRawPersist.message: Does not save raw chat text.

consentDeleteLocal.message: Uninstall or clear extension data to remove local data.

continuationPrompt.message: Create a continuation package for a new ChatGPT chat so work can resume without re-analysis. Do not merely retell the conversation and do not invent missing facts. Structure the output as: 1) Current goal and exact stage; 2) Completed work that should not be repeated; 3) Confirmed decisions, tradeoffs, and reasons; 4) Important constraints, user preferences, privacy/safety requirements, compatibility limits, and things not to do; 5) Key working state, including relevant files, paths, repositories/branches/commits, code/configuration, data, platform/account status, versions, URLs, commands, and exact UI copy when they matter; 6) Unresolved issues, known defects, failed attempts, and why they failed; 7) Next actions in priority order, beginning with the first concrete action for the new chat; 8) Risks and pitfalls that could cause duplicated work, data loss, incorrect publishing, rollback, or regressions; 9) Essential verbatim material only when exact wording matters, such as commands, errors, copy, API names, filenames, or IDs. Clearly separate confirmed facts from inference and items that still need verification. Preserve exact names, versions, paths, commit hashes, URLs, and important values. Remove greetings and irrelevant process details, but do not omit context that would change the next action. If code or files are involved, state what was changed, what was tested, what was committed/pushed/published, and what remains uncommitted or pending. Finish with a short 'Continue execution' instruction that tells the new chat to read the package first, preserve the confirmed decisions and constraints, and continue from the listed next action instead of starting over.

toastRecalibrationStarted.message: Previous reference kept as an outdated prior. Calibrate again before relying on risk levels.

toastFailureLearned.message: Calibration evidence saved from this limit event.

calibrationNoConversation.message: Open the historical chat you know reached the conversation-length limit, then try again.

calibrationParserFailed.message: Calibration was not saved because message roles could not be read reliably.

calibrationConservativeSuccess.message: Reference established. This chat includes context that cannot be measured precisely, so alerts will be more conservative.

calibrationSuccess.message: Calibration complete. The local failure reference is established.

calibrationConversationChanged.message: The conversation changed while it was being scanned. Nothing was calibrated; keep this chat open and try again.

calibrationGenerationChanged.message: The alert reference changed while scanning. Nothing was calibrated; try again.

calibrationSampleUnusable.message: This chat could not be measured reliably enough to use as a calibration sample.

toastScanFailed.message: Calibration did not finish. No failure reference was saved.

scanNoScroll.message: Conversation scroll area was not found. Refresh and try again.

scanNoMessages.message: No conversation messages are available yet. Wait for the page to finish loading.

scanHeadLoading.message: Older history did not finish stabilizing, so calibration was not saved. Keep the page open and try again.

scanTailChanging.message: The end of the conversation is still changing. Calibration was not saved.

scanAlignmentFailed.message: Part of the history could not be read continuously, so calibration was stopped instead of guessing.

scanLimitReached.message: This chat is very long and the full history could not be confirmed. Calibration was not saved.

scanIncomplete.message: Complete history was not confirmed, so calibration was not saved.
